records.label: spacr.filters.read_identity#2
records.source: path to the SQLite measurement database. It is opened read-only, so a missing file raises :class:`sqlite3.OperationalError` instead of being created as an empty database.
records.context: path to the SQLite measurement database. It is opened read-only, so a missing file throws :class:`sqlite3.OperationalError` instead of being created as an empty database.
records.translation: ruta a la base de datos de mediciones SQLite. Se abre en modo de solo lectura, por lo que, si falta el archivo, se genera :class:`sqlite3.OperationalError` en vez de crear una base de datos vacía.

records.label: spacr.filters.ensure_filters_table#1
records.source: the measurement database. An existing table is read without modification; the first call, or a rebuild, writes the identity table derived from the database's object relationships.
records.context: the measurement database. An existing table is read without modification; the first call, or a rebuild, writes the identity table derived from the database's object relationships.
records.translation: la base de datos de mediciones. Las tablas existentes se leen sin modificarlas; la primera llamada, o una reconstrucción, escribe la tabla de identidad derivada de las relaciones entre objetos de la base de datos.

records.label: spacr.filters.export_gate#1
records.source: the measurement database whose ``filters`` table is created when absent and then rewritten with the gate column.
records.context: the measurement database whose ``filters`` table is created when absent and then rewritten with the data-selection boundary column.
records.translation: la base de datos de mediciones, cuya tabla ``filters`` se crea si no existe y después se reescribe con la columna de la compuerta.

records.label: spacr.filters.gate_mask_over_table#2
records.source: path to the SQLite measurement database, opened read-only.
records.context: path to the SQLite measurement database, opened read-only.
records.translation: ruta a la base de datos de mediciones SQLite, abierta en modo de solo lectura.

records.label: spacr.filters.gate_mask_over_table#3
records.source: the object table to evaluate. Only its identity columns and the measurement columns used by the selected gate path are read.
records.context: the object table to evaluate. Only its identity columns and the measurement columns used by the selected data-selection boundary path are read.
records.translation: la tabla de objetos que se va a evaluar. Solo se leen sus columnas de identidad y las columnas de medición utilizadas por la ruta de la compuerta seleccionada.

records.label: spacr.filters.annotate_from_gates#2
records.source: the objects to label. It must contain every measurement column referenced by the selected gates; the returned Series keeps this frame's index and row order.
records.context: the objects to label. It must contain every measurement column referenced by the selected data-selection boundaries; the returned Series keeps this frame's index and row order.
records.translation: los objetos que se van a etiquetar. Debe contener todas las columnas de medición a las que hacen referencia las compuertas seleccionadas; la Series devuelta conserva el índice y el orden de filas de este marco.

records.translation: la tabla que se va a leer. Su nombre se entrecomilla como un único identificador de SQLite; si la tabla no existe, se genera :class:`sqlite3.OperationalError`.
